title: Polymer Chemistry
description: Small molecules linked into chains thousands long: but only if almost every bond forms. Unlocks the Polymeriser.

puzzle.goal: Monomers of mass m, with f reactive ends on average, link until a fraction p of the ends have reacted. Write the average mass M of a chain.
puzzle.name: Carothers
puzzle.ask: Find M in g/mol for m = @{m} g/mol (nylon), f = @{f} and p = @{p}.
puzzle.method: Each reaction joins two molecules into one: after a fraction p of the ends react, only 1 − p as many molecules are left.
